Specification: This module specifies a small state machine over two variables x and y, with an initial condition, several alternative next-state actions, and a simple temporal specification Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars. The actions illustrate different ways of referring to variables and primed variables, including helper operators c, d, and a, as well as UNCHANGED expressions over individual variables and tuples. The module also defines state invariants Inv and Inv2 and helper operators using quantified expressions over subsets and cardinality, likely to exercise analysis or coverage cost for invariant checking rather than model a realistic distributed protocol.
